note: PUBLISHED TEST KEYS. The private keys are in this repository and derived from a documented string. They protect nothing. Never use them for anything real.
derivation: d = SHA-256("cellular-defense conformance key v1: " + label) mod n, P-256

alice.purpose: Alice — primary recipient in most single-recipient vectors

bob.purpose: Bob — second recipient; also the signer in signed-cell vectors

carol.purpose: Carol — third recipient, used for quorum vectors

dave.purpose: Dave — fourth recipient, used for 3-of-4 quorum vectors

mallory.purpose: Mallory — never a recipient; the wrong-key negative case
